name: Voxel-based Ray Tracing for GI and Specular Reflections
definition: A voxel-based ray tracing system using DDA traversal through a 128³ block-occupancy grid to provide global illumination (GI) and specular reflection fallbacks.
summary: Voxel-based Ray Tracing provides global illumination and specular reflection fallbacks by traversing a 128³ voxel grid, serving as a drop-in replacement for screen-space techniques when coverage is incomplete.
